speculative.concern: a relative plan path starting with a dash is read as a cat option
speculative.why_speculative: callers pass absolute plan paths; failure is closed
speculative.real_if: a caller passes a relative path starting with a dash

speculative.concern: an unapproved unit-first plan in flight fails render, challenge and approve
speculative.why_speculative: it fails closed and names the field
speculative.real_if: unapproved unit-first plans are in flight when this lands

speculative.concern: two reviewer ids that title-case to the same name give two identical groups
speculative.real_if: an artifact mixes lens-x and lens-x-reviewer

speculative.concern: re-checking a speculative item or a rejected test reuses a verdict that requires severity
speculative.why_speculative: a new use, not a break for an existing consumer
speculative.real_if: the verdict is validated and an invented severity is rejected

speculative.concern: a plan changed during authoring and restored before the check goes unseen
speculative.why_speculative: the only writer then is the author, which can write anything
speculative.real_if: someone other than tests-developer can write the plan mid-dispatch

speculative.concern: arbiter prose shown under a plan render could mimic plan sections
speculative.why_speculative: the digest binds the plan bytes; the ruling is structured
speculative.real_if: arbiter prose is pasted verbatim instead of one line per test

speculative.concern: a whitespace-only reviewer name renders as a thematic break
speculative.why_speculative: the orchestrator sets reviewer to an agent id
speculative.real_if: the reviewer field ever comes from report text

speculative.concern: a builds-on folder and a file with the same segments render the same label
speculative.why_speculative: no file path ends in a slash
speculative.real_if: a plan lists builds-on X/ beside a file X

speculative.concern: ./a/f and a/f for one file get a dot label
speculative.why_speculative: needs mixed path spellings in one artifact
speculative.real_if: reviewers in one swarm emit ./-prefixed and bare locations

speculative.concern: a missing id fails only the item map after the Markdown was written
speculative.real_if: an artifact is hand-edited outside the scripts

findings.trigger: a repair entry in a file that also holds a planned test, with 2+ files listed
findings.problem: a repair or delete entry omits its file when Files lists it, so moving it between files renders the same
findings.fix: always show the file on repair and delete entries

findings.trigger: a jest plan with unit tests under __tests__/parser.js
findings.problem: the unit-tests-inline marker only checks the file name for test or spec
findings.fix: match test directories and word-bounded test or spec tokens

findings.trigger: rendering any draft plan
findings.problem: a draft says 0 rejected before any review happened
findings.fix: show the rejected count only once the reviewer section exists

findings.trigger: a location containing two backticks in a row
findings.realism_reason: locations are file paths; double backticks do not occur
findings.problem: a double backtick in a location ends its code span early
findings.fix: size the fence to the longest backtick run plus one

findings.trigger: a reviewer emits file:line:col locations for two same-named files
findings.realism_reason: the contract allows only file:line and file:start-end
findings.problem: a line:col location is read as part of the file name
findings.fix: allow an optional :col in the location pattern

findings.trigger: the next editor trusts the header rule that every heading carries a count
findings.problem: the header says all headings carry counts; several do not
findings.fix: state exactly which headings and labels carry counts

findings.trigger: the next change to which values need block-marker escaping
findings.problem: the block-marker rule is stated twice in different words
findings.fix: point the rules entry to the header WHY block

findings.trigger: the next edit to the copy or status logic
findings.problem: inline comments restate the header WHY blocks
findings.fix: keep the header as the single rationale

findings.trigger: a peer plan with a unit test before an e2e test reaches render, approve or amend
findings.problem: the e2e-first rule runs on stored plans, so an in-flight plan can no longer render, approve or be reordered
findings.fix: enforce the order only on bodies being written, never on a stored plan

findings.trigger: the reviewer moves a unit test to e2e, or a rejected e2e test is restored at the end
findings.problem: only tests-developer was told e2e tests come first; the reviewer and orchestrator revisions fail
findings.fix: tell both: keep e2e tests first and renumber after a move or restore

findings.trigger: the human answers confirm 3 or ACK 5 at the Address question
findings.problem: items are numbered without ids and no script maps a number back to its finding id
findings.fix: print the number-to-id map from the renderer and use it in the prose

findings.trigger: a reviewer writes a 120-character realism_reason
findings.problem: the 100-character cap on the new fields is not stated where reviewers read
findings.fix: state at most 100 characters in review-core

findings.trigger: any review governed by a spec
findings.problem: the prose promises a Spec line but the renderer never shows spec_ref
findings.fix: render the Spec line after the title

findings.trigger: any finding with more than one location
findings.problem: extra locations are specified three different ways across the renderer and two documents
findings.fix: pick one shape in review-report-standards and follow it everywhere

findings.trigger: the human picks a re-check option
findings.problem: re-check sends the arbiter items its contract does not cover: non-blocking, speculative, rejected tests
findings.fix: widen the arbiter's mandate and verdict, or drop the plan re-check

findings.trigger: a flow-review re-check where the arbiter rules a finding speculative
findings.problem: the Address question is copied into flow-review and already differs from its owner
findings.fix: point to flow-implementation section 5 and keep only the recording mapping

findings.trigger: a review whose only open findings are realistic MEDIUM or LOW
findings.problem: the human can choose MEDIUMs to fix, but the loop never opens a round for them
findings.fix: say a chosen MEDIUM or LOW opens a fix round, and align the loop text

findings.trigger: the next reader of section 5b
findings.problem: stale references to per-finding id blocks and a 5d summary
findings.fix: reword to the new relay

findings.trigger: the orchestrator builds the fields file from section 5c
findings.problem: the persist rule omits realism_reason and real_if
findings.fix: name both fields in the persist sentence

findings.trigger: an edge case filed without realism_reason
findings.problem: the Trigger fallback for edge cases is not documented
findings.fix: document the fallback like the speculative one

findings.trigger: rendering a report with a conflict note
findings.problem: the example verdict line counts a class the rule does not define
findings.fix: list for your decision as a counted class, or drop it

findings.trigger: a lens emits a conflict note in a flow-review swarm
findings.problem: conflicts are now numbered under the relay, but a decided conflict has no recording or brief route
findings.fix: say how a decided conflict is recorded and briefed

findings.trigger: every flow-testing test review render
findings.problem: Plan conformance names the reviewer as its source, but the reviewer has no such field
findings.fix: name both sources: tests-developer counts and the reviewer plan findings

findings.trigger: an injected plan writes a fixture into src/main/resources or .github/workflows
findings.problem: new and deleted files show only their name, so the human cannot see where approved writes land
findings.fix: show the folder for new and deleted files

findings.trigger: re-check of an edge-case HIGH where the arbiter, reading injected code, rules it speculative
findings.problem: re-check applies an arbiter demotion of a CRITICAL or HIGH without the human
findings.fix: apply only promotions; a demoted CRITICAL or HIGH stays a human decision

findings.trigger: a reviewer copies bidi or hidden characters from a reviewed repo into a finding
findings.problem: the review render strips only control characters; bidi, hidden and HTML text reach the human
findings.fix: reuse the test-plan forbidden-character set and escape HTML and links

findings.trigger: an edge case marked needs your decision
findings.problem: confirmation is shown by location and trigger, but edge lines now show only the reason
findings.fix: show the trigger on a needs-your-decision edge case

findings.trigger: the next reader of the Realism floor invariant
findings.problem: it cites review-core for the Address choice, which lives in the flows
findings.fix: cite flow-implementation section 5 and flow-review section 5d

findings.trigger: the human chooses a speculative item by number
findings.problem: a chosen or promoted speculative item cannot be recorded, filed by the reviewer, or retired from the list
findings.fix: define the speculative lifecycle: elect, file as a finding, retire the entry

findings.problem: the Approved line lists numbers in stored order, e.g. 1, 2, 4, 3
findings.fix: sort the numbers ascending
findings.trigger: an amend moves a test so its number changes

findings.problem: a prose builds-on entry keeps a slash inside a code span
findings.fix: show prose builds-on entries as plain text
findings.trigger: a builds-on entry written as prose, like helper in tests/x.sh

findings.problem: a backslash cancels the plain-text escape after it
findings.fix: escape the backslash first
findings.trigger: a builds-on entry with a backslash before an escaped character
findings.realism_reason: only builds-on allows a backslash, and it needs a name collision

findings.problem: the header says no value renders a link, but bare URLs still autolink
findings.fix: qualify the claim to inline and HTML links
findings.trigger: a finding cites a bare https URL and the file is viewed on GitHub

findings.problem: the question has no follow-ups-only option, so it can shrink to one choice
findings.fix: add a follow-ups-only option
findings.trigger: only one Address option has items

findings.problem: an undecided needs-your-decision item has no default
findings.fix: re-ask until each needs-your-decision item is answered
findings.trigger: the human answers 1, 4 while an edge-case HIGH awaits a decision

findings.problem: where rulings show, and the hold rule covering only security, are unstated
findings.fix: show one ruling line per item; widen the hold to data integrity and safety
findings.trigger: the human picks re-check first

findings.problem: the reviewer has no re-check variant: input file and output use are undefined
findings.fix: define the re-check input and that its plan revision is not persisted
findings.trigger: the human picks re-check rejected first

findings.problem: PENDING past the re-entry reads as never briefed, but unchosen follow-ups stay PENDING
findings.fix: say unchosen follow-ups stay PENDING by design
findings.trigger: a follow-up the human did not choose

findings.problem: draft test numbers in reasons clash with the renumbered render
findings.fix: cite tests by name in reasons
findings.trigger: the reviewer cites a draft test number in a rejection reason
